source_title: J&K CM Omar Abdullah and journalist Nidhi Razdan get married

Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah with journalist Nidhi Razdan. Credit: X/@OmarAbdullah
Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah, 56, on Saturday announced his marriage with journalist Nidhi Razan, a day after a lowkey ceremony held in New Delhi.
Posting the wedding pictures on X , Mr. Abdullah said, “A new journey began yesterday.” Ms. Razdan also posted pictures with a joyful message, “It’s done bro”.
The announcement evoked a barrage of congratulatory messages from netizens, including friends and party workers.
“Heartiest congratulations to Mr. Abdullah sahib and Nidhi ji on starting this new journey together. Wishing you both a lifetime of happiness and togetherness. Best wishes for a wonderful journey ahead!” said NC spokesman Imran Nabi Dar.
Family sources said the Abdullahs and the Razdans held a family function in Srinagar this month, ahead of the formal announcement in New Delhi. They said the marriage was registered on October 30 formally. Mr. Abdullah and Ms. Razdan were spotted together very frequently in Jammu and Kashmir, even at official functions.
The second marriage of Mr. Abdullah came three months after a long drawn legal battle over his divorce which ended in “a mutual consent settlement” in the Supreme Court of India on July 31, 2026. In 1994, Mr. Abdullah married Payal Nath, the daughter of Major General Ram Nath, four years before he entered politics. Mr. Abdullah announced his separation from Ms. Nath in 2011.

द हिंदू में प्रकाशित रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, जम्मू-कश्मीर के मुख्यमंत्री उमर अब्दुल्ला और पत्रकार निधि राजदान ने नई दिल्ली में हुए एक सादे समारोह के बाद अपनी शादी की घोषणा की है।

56 वर्षीय श्री अब्दुल्ला ने सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म एक्स पर शादी की तस्वीरें साझा करते हुए लिखा, "कल एक नई यात्रा शुरू हुई।" सुश्री राजदान ने भी तस्वीरें साझा करते हुए लिखा, "यह हो गया ब्रो"। पारिवारिक सूत्रों के अनुसार, इस महीने की शुरुआत में श्रीनगर में एक पारिवारिक कार्यक्रम के बाद, 30 अक्टूबर को शादी को औपचारिक रूप से पंजीकृत किया गया था।

## प्रतिक्रियाएं और पृष्ठभूमि

इस घोषणा के बाद सोशल मीडिया और राजनीतिक हलकों से बधाइयों का तांता लग गया। नेशनल कॉन्फ्रेंस के प्रवक्ता इमरान नबी दार ने दोनों को सुखद भविष्य की शुभकामनाएं दीं।

* **पिछला विवाह और कानूनी प्रक्रिया:** रिपोर्टों में बताया गया है कि यह श्री अब्दुल्ला का दूसरा विवाह है। इससे पहले 31 जुलाई 2026 को भारत के सुप्रीम कोर्ट में आपसी सहमति से उनके पिछले तलाक का निपटारा हुआ था। उन्होंने 1994 में पायल नाथ से विवाह किया था और 2011 में उनसे अलग होने की घोषणा की थी।
* **सार्वजनिक रूप से दिखना:** पारिवारिक सूत्रों के अनुसार, श्री अब्दुल्ला और सुश्री राजदान को जम्मू-कश्मीर में, आधिकारिक कार्यक्रमों सहित, अक्सर एक साथ देखा गया था।

पाठक संबंधित व्यक्तियों के आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया हैंडल के माध्यम से या द हिंदू जैसे समाचार प्लेटफार्मों पर मूल घोषणा की सत्यता की जांच कर सकते हैं।

en_body:
Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and journalist Nidhi Razdan announced their marriage following a low-key ceremony held in New Delhi, according to reports published by The Hindu. 

Mr. Abdullah, 56, shared wedding pictures on the social media platform X, stating, "A new journey began yesterday." Ms. Razdan also posted pictures with the message, "It’s done bro." Family sources reported that the marriage was formally registered on October 30, following a family function held in Srinagar earlier in the month.

## Reactions and Background

The announcement drew congratulatory messages from across the political spectrum and social media, including National Conference spokesman Imran Nabi Dar, who wished the couple a lifetime of happiness.

* **Previous Marriage and Legal Proceedings:** Reports noted that this is Mr. Abdullah's second marriage, following a mutual consent settlement regarding his previous divorce in the Supreme Court of India on July 31, 2026. He had previously married Payal Nath in 1994, with whom he announced a separation in 2011.
* **Public Sightings:** According to family sources, Mr. Abdullah and Ms. Razdan had frequently been seen together in Jammu and Kashmir, including at official functions.

Readers can verify the original announcement through official social media handles of the individuals or by checking updates on established news platforms such as The Hindu.
